p.i: Ira nescia parcere, Ira per Solymam efferas Læta spargere strages.

TErrorum varia modò convenere cohortes Tuis vocata nutibus, solemnia Ceu, quum frequens ad festa plebs vocatur. Illa me simul obsident, Et duro examinem discruciant metu. Nemo fugit hostium Densa tela ferocium. Et quos fouebam lacteolo sinu Heu! cunctos (commoto Numine) savientis ardens Dextra perdidit hostis, Et nulli furibunda pepercit.
HEu, heu, me Superûm multiplici verbere contudit Commotus furor, & mortiferis cladibus obruit.

page.notes: Woodcut-style initials T and H read as printed. Greek word "ἐπίμικτον" is partly worn; the reading is doubtful. "Læta" has a ligature that may be æ or ę; read as æ. The printed "Nunc" is a catchword at the foot and is therefore not repeated in the text.
